name: rfdiffusion3
description: Generate protein backbones/designs with RFdiffusion3 (RFD3, all-atom diffusion) on Aurora XPU; one row per design (one tile), returns a generated CIF (.cif.gz) + metrics JSON. Unconditional (length) or spec-driven (binder/hotspots, motif/enzyme, symmetry, partial).
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool rfdiffusion3.generate(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=scripts/rfdiffusion3_run_row.py, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). A row is EITHER unconditional (give 'length', spec omitted -> inputs=null +specification.length=<length>) OR spec-driven (give 'spec' = inline JSON text or an absolute path to a JSON/YAML inputs file mapping spec-name -> design config; SKILL.md §4). Install paths (foundry dir, rfd3 entry point, checkpoints) resolve worker-side from site.<system>.json -> built-in defaults. The runner runs generation via bash -lc so `module swap frameworks/2025.3.1` works (SKILL.md §1); it does NOT set ZE_AFFINITY_MASK (the EL pins the tile per row). Total designs = batches*batch_size. Distinct seeds are distinct designs.
